_comment: Business-line template: Processing Unit - Spices (turmeric/chilli/coriander/cumin). PROCESSING revenue model, per-day throughput. Whole dried spices are cleaned, dried, pulverised, graded and packed into powder. Same structure/methodology as the ghee/dal PM-FME base; 'wastage' = cleaning + grinding + moisture loss.
report_title: DETAILED PROJECT REPORT - SPICE PROCESSING UNIT

narrative.product_intro: Spice powders (such as turmeric, chilli, coriander and cumin) are produced by cleaning, drying, pulverising, grading and packing whole dried spices. Value-added, hygienically packed spice powders command a premium over raw whole spices and enjoy steady year-round household and institutional demand.
narrative.raw_material_note: The raw material is whole dried spices procured from member farmers and local mandis, plus food-grade packaging pouches; spice units are best located in spice-growing belts with assured sun-drying or dryer capacity.
process_steps: Procurement and storage of whole dried spices
Cleaning and de-stoning to remove foreign matter
Drying to the required moisture level
Sifting and grading to uniform particle size
Blending for consistent colour and quality
